verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen free-hit you with Q (Decisive Strike) off cooldown and E (Judgment) spinning; you win every trade where you land E (Ground Slam) and Q (Seismic Shard) while your Passive (Granite Shield) is charged.

brief.thesis: This is a passive-vs-passive lane: Garen's Passive (Perseverance) heals him hard if he avoids damage for a few seconds, and your Passive (Granite Shield) blocks a hit then needs time to recharge. Whoever forces the other's passive to be down wins the exchange. The 50.2% win rate over 2042 games confirms this is genuinely even, decided by who dictates engagement timing rather than raw stats.

theirWindow.when: His Q is up and shield recharged
theirWindow.what: He breaks any slow you put on him with Seismic Shard, silences you, and his bonus-damage auto lands clean. Do not stand still in melee range here — back off until it's down (8s cooldown) or bait it into hitting a minion.

yourWindow.when: His Q is down, Granite Shield is up
yourWindow.what: Walk in and land Q (Seismic Shard) to slow him so he can't kite your follow-up, then E (Ground Slam) for the armor-scaled magic damage and attack speed shred. Your shield eats his first E (Judgment) tick for free.

powerCurve.note: Both poke with Q, shields trade evenly
Garen's E ranks up, sustain outpaces your damage
R (Unstoppable Force) threatens kills, forces caution
Frozen Heart cooldown and armor win extended fights

start.why: Garen's autos and E (Judgment) ticks are physical poke; the flat damage reduction on trades and passive regen keep you ahead of his Perseverance sustain rather than racing it.

boots.why: 79.7% pick rate and 51.8% win rate here because Garen's entire kit is auto-attacks and physical spin damage — flat reduction on every hit matters more than tenacity.

core.why: AoE burn punishes him for standing in melee range to auto you, and the health/armor keep you alive through E (Judgment) spam
Garen is auto-attack reliant with no gap-close besides Q (Decisive Strike), so the reflect and grievous wounds directly counter his Perseverance healing
The attack speed slow on him cuts into his auto-attack and E uptime, and the armor stacks with your passive and E (Ground Slam) scaling

situational.when: he is building toward true damage or you need a magic shield buffer for all-ins
he is fed and his auto-attack burst with R (Demacian Justice) threatens to execute you
you are ahead and want your R (Unstoppable Force) and E (Ground Slam) to hit harder in skirmishes

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.9% win rate build — Grasp heals you on extended trades and grows your health, which directly offsets Garen's Perseverance sustain race instead of trying to out-damage it

summoners.why: 76.1% pick rate and the top win rate (49.1%) pairing — Teleport lets you reset after even trades and return with tempo, since neither side has a reliable all-in before level 6.

playing.title: Bait his Q before committing
playing.detail: Walk forward just enough to see if Garen uses Q (Decisive Strike) on a minion or whiffs it. Only trade once it's on its 8s cooldown.

playing.title: Shield-check before every trade
playing.detail: If your Granite Shield passive hasn't recharged, you take full damage from his E (Judgment). Disengage and wait for it to come back up before re-engaging.

playing.title: Use E first in extended fights
playing.detail: Ground Slam's attack speed reduction cuts directly into his auto-attack and Perseverance uptime, since his healing depends on avoiding recent damage.

playing.title: Save R for his Flash
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force (130-80s cooldown) only guarantees a kill if he can't Flash out of the knock-up, so hold it until his Flash is confirmed down.

playing.title: Don't duel him under tower at level 1-2
playing.detail: His W (Courage) absorbs your early poke damage, so short trades favor him before you have Q (Seismic Shard) rank 2.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown mid-game
playing.detail: At levels 9+ his Judgment cooldown is still 9-11s; walk him down the moment he uses it since he has no other way to stick to you besides his broken-free Q movespeed.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not early kills
playing.detail: This matchup trends even to favored for you past level 14 once Frozen Heart and Thornmail are online, so avoid forcing all-ins before your core items finish.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the win-condition reasoning and ability timing calls are my own tactical read, not statistical output.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Garen when he activates (W). Use Malphite’s passive shield to hit and run often!
